jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)

Location: On site (Denmark, near Værløse, 20 min NW of central Copenhagen)

Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Shape the Commercial Future of a High-Tech Drone Defense Company

UMag Solutions is a rapidly growing defence technology company developing and manufacturing advanced Quantum Magnetic Sensing payloads for Autonomous Systems for military, government, and allied customers around the world. Our solutions are used for land- and naval min detection as well as anti-submarine warfare.

Today, we are a team of approximately 45 highly skilled professionals. Over the next three years, we expect to triple our organization and establish subsidiaries in key international markets. This growth requires a commercial leader who can build not only business, but also the organization, leadership, and commercial capabilities needed for an internationally recognized defense company.

We are therefore seeking a visionary Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) to join our Executive Management Team.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the company while building and scaling-up a world-class commercial organization that supports our continued international expansion.

The Opportunity

As Chief Commercial Officer, you will be responsible for executing the company's commercial strategy and leading all customer-facing functions throughout the customer lifecycle.

You will lead the Commercial Organization through four experienced functional leaders:

• Sales

• Marketing

• Technical Solutions, Support & Partnerships

• Operations & Logistics

Together, these departments are responsible for creating market awareness, developing business opportunities, managing customer and drone-partner relationships, planning and executing customer demonstrations worldwide, delivering products, managing customer support and training, and ensuring long-term customer success.

Your mission is to align these functions into one integrated commercial organization capable of supporting international growth while maintaining operational excellence and exceptional customer experience.

As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will work closely with the CEO and fellow executives to shape company strategy, drive growth, and ensure the organization is prepared for its next stage of development.

Your Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership

• Execute the company's commercial strategy in alignment with the corporate strategy.

• Lead and develop the Commercial Leadership Team.

• Create alignment across all customer-facing functions.

• Establish a culture focused on customer success and sustainable growth.

• Build the commercial organization required to support international expansion.

Sales

Through the Head of Sales, you will:

• Drive sustainable revenue growth.

• Develop strategic customer relationships.

• Lead commercial planning and sales forecasting.

• Strengthen opportunity management and pipeline quality.

• Support major negotiations and strategic customer engagements.

• Improve commercial processes and performance.

Marketing

Through the Head of Marketing, you will:

• Strengthen the company's international market position.

• Develop marketing strategies supporting business growth.

• Build brand awareness within the global defense sector.

• Oversee product positioning, communications, digital marketing, and industry events.

• Ensure marketing activities generate measurable commercial value.

Technical Solutions, Support & Partnerships

Through the Head of Technical Solutions & Partnerships, you will:

• Develop scalable E-learning and physical training material for all products.

• Develop and strengthen long-term customer, drone and re-seller partner relationships.

• Support all commercial functions (sales, marketing, operations, support) with relevant advanced technical information when needed

• Improve customer satisfaction and retention.

• Establish scalable customer support processes

• Ensure world-class after-sales support.

• Develop service offerings supporting recurring business.

Operations & Logistics

Through the Head of Operations, Support & Logistics, you will:

• Ensure professional planning and execution of customer demonstrations worldwide.

• Make sure that our operation team members and other employees are up-to-speed on products before going on product demonstrations or tradeshows

• Oversee commercial logistics related to demonstrations and customer deliveries.

• Ensure timely and compliant international shipment of products.

• Continuously improve customer-facing operational processes.

• Coordinate testing of prototype hardware and software solutions before stable releases

Strategic Responsibilities

As the company scales, you will play a key role in building the commercial organization of the future.

This includes:

• Designing scalable commercial structures and governance.

• Developing commercial KPIs and performance management.

• Building leadership capabilities throughout the commercial organization.

• Supporting the establishment of international subsidiaries.

• Standardizing commercial processes across multiple locations.

• Driving cross-functional collaboration between Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Engineering, Production, Finance, and Product Management.

• Supporting strategic partnerships, international market expansion, and long-term growth initiatives.

Who You Are

You are an experienced and fast-moving commercial executive who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence.

You are not afraid of using and implementing AI wherever it makes sense in the commercial organization.

You have successfully built and led commercial organizations during periods of rapid growth and understand how to create structure without losing agility.

You thrive in environments where you can influence strategy while remaining close to execution.

Most importantly, you enjoy developing people, building strong leadership teams, and creating organizations capable of sustained international growth.

Qualifications

We expect you to bring:

• A university degree in Business, Engineering, Military Studies, or a related field.

• Significant senior commercial leadership experience, preferably as a Chief Commercial Officer, Senior Business Developer, Commercial Director, VP Commercial, or similar executive role.

• Experience from a high-tech product company, preferably within defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing.

• Demonstrated success scaling commercial organizations in a growing company.

• Experience leading leaders and developing management teams.

• Strong understanding of complex B2G and B2B sales environments.

• Experience with international customers and government procurement processes.

• Strong commercial, financial, and strategic business acumen.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

International travel should be expected to partner companies, product demonstrations and tradeshows.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first years, you will have:

• Strengthened collaboration across all customer-facing functions.

• Positioned the company as a preferred partner within the international defense and drone industry.

• Built an integrated, high-performing commercial organization.

• Implemented AI in all relevant processes

• Improved commercial forecasting and governance.

• Increased customer satisfaction.

• Established scalable commercial processes capable of supporting continued growth beyond 100 employees.

• Supported successful international expansion.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a traditional commercial leadership role.

You will join a fast-moving and highly innovative tech company at a defining moment in its journey—from an innovative scale-up to an internationally recognized defense technology company backed by the Bridgepoint Group.

As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will have significant influence on our strategic direction, organizational development, and international growth. You will work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about delivering advanced capabilities to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.

If you are motivated by building organizations, developing leaders, and creating commercial excellence in a high-growth international tech business, we would like to hear from you.

Send your CV and application to hire@umagsolutions.com

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.description:
Do you want to lead infrastructure projects that power and protect Europe’s future? Do you have the experience, leadership skills and commercial mindset needed to deliver some of Europe’s most strategic energy infrastructure projects? And can you lead multidisciplinary teams? Then, come join COWI!  **Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**At COWI, we help our clients address some of society’s most important challenges.

The energy landscape is changing rapidly. Europe is investing in resilient energy infrastructure, decarbonisation, critical infrastructure and strategic energy systems that strengthen security of supply and societal resilience.

To support this development, we are looking for an experienced Project Director to join our Green Energy infrastructure team in Lyngby.

You will become part of our engineering environment working with:

• CO₂ transportation and storage

• Gas transmission systems

• LNG and ammonia terminals

• Energy storage facilities

• Critical infrastructure

As Project Director, you will play a key role in guiding clients through feasibility assessments, concept development, Pre-FEED and FEED phases, before supporting implementation through detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

You will be responsible for leading multidisciplinary teams across Denmark and our international delivery centres while ensuring technical quality, commercial performance and strong client relationships.

• Act as Project Director on feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Support clients in defining and developing future energy infrastructure investments.

• Develop trusted long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

• Lead international and multidisciplinary project teams.

• Mentor and develop project managers and technical specialists.

• Contribute to COWI’s growth within Energy Security, Resilience and Critical Infrastructure.

On top of that, you will have:

• The technical understanding needed to engage with specialists, challenge technical solutions and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Experience from feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and/or Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Strong commercial understanding and contract management experience.

• Experience managing large projects and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

• Experience working in international project environments.

• A relevant engineering degree.

We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Peter Malmkjær, Head of Projects, Green Energy Pipelines at PRMR@COWI.COM.
